cross_source_robustness.train counsel_chat -> test RED: within each fold: train on the training CounselChat dialogues, test on the test-fold RED dialogues
cross_source_robustness.why: in-source proxy macro-F1 0.47 drops to 0.36-0.38 across sources (docs/experiments/2026-10-05-split-review.md)

design: 5-fold CV grouped by same-post/duplicate cluster, stratified by source. For test fold k, dev = fold (k+1) mod 5. Every dialogue is tested exactly once.
label_subset: listener rows with stage1_agreed (ann1 == ann2): 7152 rows; the remaining rows are context only
notes: Duplicate dialogues and same-post threads (containment >= 0.10) share a fold; stratified by source.
scheme: Welivita, a MITI variant (15 codes; maps to MITI 4.2.1 via registry.WELIVITA_TO_MITI)

variance_rules.fold_draw: for k-fold designs, re-draw the fold assignment with each training seed (seed-tied) or use leave-one-session-out, so no result rests on one fold assignment
variance_rules.intervals: 95% CI from resampling sessions (clusters), on top of the across-seed spread
variance_rules.pairing: compare arms at the same seed and the same folds; report the mean of paired differences
variance_rules.single_split: do not report a single random train/test split as a headline: use the grouped k-fold CV
variance_rules.training_seeds: at least 3 matched seeds (42, 1, 2) for any claimed difference; one seed = exploratory only
